model_annotation: The figure presents three donut-style pie charts showing how four sectors (industry, construction, trade, and other services) contribute to the total economy in 2021 for three measures: number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover; each chart contains 4 slices and uses a shared legend indicating industry in yellow, construction in light blue, trade in red, and other services in dark blue, with percentage labels and absolute values printed inside the slices and no exploded or offset segments. In the “Number of enterprises” chart, other services (dark blue) is about 61% (19.0 mln), trade (red) about 19% (5.9 mln), construction (light blue) about 12% (3.7 mln), and industry (yellow) about 8% (2.4 mln). In the “Number of persons employed” chart, other services (dark blue) is about 51% (80.2 mln), industry (yellow) about 21% (33.0 mln), trade (red) about 19% (29.5 mln), and construction (light blue) about 9% (13.4 mln). In the “Turnover” chart, industry (yellow) is about 33% (10.6 tln), other services (dark blue) about 31% (9.8 tln), trade (red) about 31% (9.9 tln), and construction (light blue) about 6% (1.9 tln); the slice ordering appears consistent around each ring rather than strictly sorted by size.
